title: 生涯スポーツ演習(バドミントン)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports (Badminton)
courseType:
Student and Study Skills Courses Program
Character Building Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for badminton, students will: 1)Understand the pleasure derived from sports. 2)Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle. 3)Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve these learning objectives through badminton. To acquire the ability to plan, implement,evaluate, and improve the following contents will be carried out in group activities. 1. Learning and practicing basic knowledge of badminton competition (how to play the game based on competition rules) 2. Game planning and management of badminton competitions 3. Competition management based on a management plan 4. Review of competition management results and examination of improvement measures Classes will be held once per week (100 minutes). Students are required to have appropriate clothing for winter activities. ( In winter, classes are mainly conducted at the gymnasium, so we recommend wearing warmer clothing.) Because the learning activities are evaluated, students are required to participate in all learning programs and manage their own physical condition.
requiredKnowledge: Basic understanding of a good mental attitude (e.g., safety awareness, following rules, discipline, respect and compassion for friends, competitive spirit)for sports activities. Basic understanding roles and responsibilities as a group members for doing group work. Basic positive communication skills with other group members.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for badminton and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime.(2) Learn fundamental badminton skills and utilize them fully in class activities.(3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4)Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.(5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6)Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime.(2) Learn fundamental badminton skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3)Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5)Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits.(6)Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: How to participate in this class safely, learn to use the necessary equipment, and understand the rules ofcompetition. Learn basic techniques in simple games. Confirm the status of learning.
lessons.operation: In lectures: 1. Learn a support plan for class management. 2. Tools used, safety, rules of competition; simple half-court game.
lessons.assignments: Review simple singles games and check the rules of competition. ★Write a portfolio report on life habits.

lessons.content: Learn the basic techniques of badminton and use them repeatedly in simple games. Confirm the status of learning.
lessons.operation: Manage a badminton competition; lecture about how to light up; simple half-court game.
lessons.assignments: Review the game, check the rules, and consider improvements in technology and tactics. ★Write a portfolio report on life habits.

lessons.content: Learn about planning a badminton competition. In a group, discuss the preparations for the management plan for the next badminton competition. Play games while simulating the operation of a badminton competition. Confirm the status of learning.
lessons.operation: After explaining the competition planning in a lecture format, group meetings will be held; skill groups will be reorganized and the creation of a badminton competition plan will be discussed before playing any games.
lessons.assignments: ★Report 1 Submit the badminton competition plan by the designated date. ★Write a portfolio report on life habits.

lessons.content: Play matches based on the badminton competition plan, and learn how to proceed with the competition, referee, and record management information. Confirm the status of learning.
lessons.operation: A badminton competition will be held based on the plan. (Competition 1)
lessons.assignments: Organize the results of the competition. Evaluate and check the operation of the competition. ★Write a portfolio report on life habits.

lessons.content: Play matches based on the badminton competition plan. Deepen your understanding of how the competition will proceed, refereeing methods, and recording of management methods. Confirm the status of learning.
lessons.operation: A badminton competition will be held based on the plan. (Competition 3)
lessons.assignments: Organize the results of the competition. Evaluate and check the operation of the competition. ★Write a portfolio report on life habits.

lessons.content: Play matches based on the badminton competition plan. Deepen your understanding of how the competition will proceed, refereeing methods, and recording of management methods. Confirm the status of learning.
lessons.operation: A badminton competition will be held based on the plan. (Competition 3)
lessons.assignments: Organize the results of the competition. Evaluate and check the operation of the competition. ★Submit Report 2 by the specified date. ★Write a portfolio report on life habits.

lessons.content: Play matches based on the badminton competition plan Deepen your understanding of how the competition will proceed, refereeing methods, and recording of management methods. Check the results of the learning activities from this class. Create a class questionnaire.
lessons.operation: A badminton competition will be held based on the plan. (Competition 4) Check the results of the learning activities in gymnasium.
